text: Buyer Metro Traders confirmed 500 cartons of basmati rice at 240 rupees per carton.
Supplier Shree Agro offered 30 days from invoice and delivery by 12 December.
खरीदार मेट्रो ट्रेडर्स ने 500 कार्टन चावल के लिए 240 रुपये प्रति कार्टन की पुष्टि की।
Supplier Shree Agro ne bola payment 30 din baad invoice se aur delivery 12 December ko.
Our counteroffer was 220 rupees per carton, but the supplier did not accept it.

ground_truth.note: Negated acceptance: extraction of price is valid; acceptance is NOT established.

text: The buyer replied 'seen' and gave no price confirmation.

ground_truth.note: Ambiguous acknowledgement: no term should be extracted as accepted.

text: Freight of 1500 rupees is included in the quoted price of 240 rupees per carton.

ground_truth.note: Freight is a separate amount; do not conflate with unit price.

text: विक्रेता श्री एग्रो ने कहा कि डिलीवरी 12 दिसंबर को होगी, लेकिन खरीदार सहमत नहीं हुए।
Rate 240 rs per carton final? Supplier ne nahi bola confirm.

ground_truth.note: Question form plus negation: price mentioned, not accepted.

text: Please send the invoice within 7 days of delivery; payment due 30 days after invoice.
